# HiInterval

HiInterval is a native interval training timer for iPhone and iPad.
It focuses on configurable workout structure, glanceable phase colors, local history, and privacy.

## Canonical
https://hiinterval.malaber.de/

## Public pages
- https://hiinterval.malaber.de/capabilities/
- https://hiinterval.malaber.de/support/
- https://hiinterval.malaber.de/privacy/

## Access model
- Early access: unlimited and free.
- Future free start: until both at least 30 days have passed and 10 workouts have been completed.
- Future ongoing free use: 3 completed workouts per calendar month.
- Planned unlimited options: EUR 1/year or EUR 5 lifetime, with local App Store equivalents potentially varying.
